verdict.rationale: Firebase documents realtime listeners that keep data in sync across connected clients. A hands-on community report describes syncing tile positions to multiple clients at once, which approximates broadcasting shared state. The pack contains no documentation of presence tracking (connection/online status, disconnect handling) or of a true ephemeral, non-persisted broadcast channel. Missing for 10: documented presence/online-status tracking, disconnect handling, an ephemeral (non-persisted) broadcast mechanism, first-party docs specific to this use case.
